scope: Windows production packaged Electron + unchanged official stdio MCP example + local negative fixtures; loopback model

working_tree.note: This evidence describes the dirty working tree and verified directory package, not HEAD or a published release.

versions.host_implementation: Direct standard JSON-RPC host; SDK is pinned reference and verification dependency, not injected into the component.

sources.example_changes: None. Official published distribution was installed and executed as shipped; stored HTML compared byte-for-byte.

supported: Catalog preserves _meta.ui resourceUri/visibility/outputSchema; model schemas/search/list/guessed execution exclude app-only tools.
openai/outputTemplate resource pointer alias only; standard resourceUri takes precedence.
Exact ui:// identity, one self-contained text/html;profile=mcp-app resource <=2 MiB; server/config/connection/content/policy cache identity.
Public content and structuredContent, private result _meta hydration outside served directory; <=200 KiB initial private snapshot.
ui/initialize 2026-01-26 and ui/notifications/initialized; source-window and host lease identity without proprietary component fields.
After initialized: ui/notifications/tool-input then tool-result exactly once; raw CallToolResult preserved for component.

tools/call through ordinary coordinator/worker/executor/security_policy/permission_review/approval/session lock; original server and live connection, current mode and app visibility, initial allowlist <=32.
Server isError remains a tool result; host refusals are JSON-RPC errors; durable receipts and instance-namespaced IDs prevent write replay.
User-text ui/message stages a proposal; only explicit host button sends a normal model turn.
Text/JSON ui/update-model-context <=8 KiB, last update, temporary untrusted user data with provenance; never system or persisted history.
Initial theme/locale/inline hostContext; bounded size-changed height 120-800 px.
ui/notifications/request-teardown and host ui/resource-teardown with <=500 ms ack wait; execution revoked immediately.
UI failures retain useful original tool text in both model and user paths; metadata-only results get generic public text, never a raw dump.
rejected: Unknown UI protocol versions, malformed/out-of-order messages, duplicates, old source/lease/revision/session, oversize/rate/concurrency overflow.
App-only calls from model, model-only calls from app, cross-server/changed generation/stale connection; Writer-mode MCP callbacks.
Nonempty requested CSP origins/frames/base origins, browser permissions or legacy widgetCSP; wrong MIME/URI/missing/oversize resources degrade to text.
Node/preload/parent DOM/network/window.open/download/navigation/permission access; never trust frame user-gesture assertions.
ui/open-link, UI tools/list/resources proxy/sampling and unknown methods are not advertised and return explicit request errors.
Private reverie/* methods are refused on the standard MCP App channel; no riu/* replacement protocol.
unverified_or_outside_profile: Real HTTP/SSE UI interoperability and a real server negotiating MCP core 2025-11-25 (accepted code path alone is not interoperability proof).
Real external model/provider/service, OAuth, Linux/macOS, installer/portable release acceptance.
Full window.openai or Plugin Extensions compatibility; only the outputTemplate pointer alias is supported.
Dynamic hostContext/theme updates, partial tool input/tool-cancelled notifications, fullscreen/pip/display-mode changes and all multimodal content.
Forced unmount/process termination cannot guarantee a teardown ack; notification is best effort, security revocation is immediate.
Long-lived connections across idle worker eviction (currently 30 seconds), restart or disconnect: callback is rejected; fresh tool invocation is required, no implicit reconnect/replay.
